hypotheses.title: Actual Operating Cash Flow Yield Accretion with Turnover Calibration
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Actual Cash Flow Per Share (anl4_af_cfps_value, Matrix 100% permitted) measures organic liquidity generation per share devoid of non-cash accounting accruals. Scaling cash flow per share by the equity price provides a pristine cash yield metric. In Batch 292, Candidate 2 achieved a positive Sharpe of 0.56, Fitness of 0.35, and perfect weight distribution with an ultra-low turnover of 1.92%. Calibrating the decay window from 10 days to 5 days accelerates portfolio rebalancing into recent price dislocations, aiming to lift turnover toward the optimal 4%-6% liquidity corridor and push Fitness past the 0.50 threshold.
confounders: Cyclical capital goods industries where working capital swings temporarily inflate annual cash flow per share
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if cash flow per share yield yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Attempt 2 of 3: Subindustry-neutralized 5-day linear decay of actual cash flow per share scaled by closing stock price.

hypotheses.title: Cyclical Cash Flow Yield Percentile Dislocation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Cross-sectional valuation ratios often suffer from structural firm-specific level differences. By evaluating a firm's current cash flow yield (anl4_af_cfps_value / close) relative to its own 60-day historical percentile distribution via ts_rank, we isolate temporary valuation discounts where current cash generation is historically high relative to recent stock price. Subindustry ranking this normalized signal focuses capital on intra-industry cyclical bargain opportunities.
confounders: Companies undergoing secular operational contraction where trailing cash flows fail to predict forward insolvency
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if cash flow yield percentile yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 5-day decay of 60-day rolling time-series rank of actual cash flow yield.

hypotheses.title: Fundamental Multi-Factor Acceleration Momentum Inflection
hypotheses.economic_rationale: multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative (Matrix, 100% coverage in TOP3000) measures the second derivative of the comprehensive multi-factor fundamental score. While fundamental levels adjust slowly, acceleration reflects early operational inflection points where revenue, margin expansion, and balance sheet quality are improving at an increasing rate. Ranking 5-day decayed multi-factor acceleration within subindustries captures positive fundamental momentum inflections before sell-side consensus revisions catch up.
confounders: One-off asset sales or tax windfalls creating false acceleration spikes in composite scores
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if multi-factor acceleration yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 0.50 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 5-day linear decay of multi-factor fundamental acceleration score derivative.
